title: 광명산업(주) — claimed by blacklocks
description:
KR · Manufacturing · Kwangmyung Industry is a manufacturing company established in 1985 that produces automotive parts, including automotive seats, molds, and jigs.
Domestic operations consist of the headquarters, the Cheonan Central Research Institute, Asan, Gwangju, and Gyeongju factories, as well as the Export Division and Kwangmyung Engineering.
Overseas subsidiaries include facilities in Ramos, Mexico, and Alab
